quests.instruction: Aisha is getting dressed for school. Which question helps her choose what to wear?
quests.correctAnswer: What is the weather like today? 🌦️
options: How many windows does my room have? 🪟
What color is the school bus? 🚌
What is the weather like today? 🌦️
quests.hint: Focus on what clothes do for you.
quests.explanation: Clothes protect you from the weather, so checking it helps you choose. The bus color and windows don't change what you need.
quests.funFact: Looking out the window is a quick way to check the weather.

quests.instruction: Kofi's shirt is inside out. What can he do?
quests.correctAnswer: Take it off, flip it, and put it on 👕
options: Leave it on and hide the seams 🙈
Take it off, flip it, and put it on 👕
quests.hint: Tags and seams are usually inside.
quests.explanation: Seams and tags are meant to be inside, so flipping the shirt makes it comfortable and neat.
quests.funFact: You can check whether a shirt is inside out by looking for the tag and seams.

quests.instruction: Zoya wants to put on her pants without falling over. What is the best way?
quests.correctAnswer: Sit down and put one leg in at a time 🪑
options: Sit down and put one leg in at a time 🪑
Hop on one foot while pulling both legs in 🦘
Pull them up over her head 🙆
quests.explanation: Sitting steadies you, and putting in one leg at a time keeps you from tipping over.
quests.funFact: Putting clothes on while sitting is also useful when learning to dress yourself.

quests.instruction: Leo is leaving for school on a cool morning. What is a sensible choice for his feet?
quests.correctAnswer: Closed shoes with socks 👟
quests.hint: He will walk and play at school.
quests.explanation: Closed shoes with socks protect feet and are comfortable for walking, running, and playing.
quests.funFact: Some schools have a rule about footwear for safety.

quests.instruction: Why might a school ask children to bring a spare change of clothes?
quests.correctAnswer: Accidents like spills happen 💧
quests.explanation: Spills, mud, or muddy puddles can happen. A spare outfit lets you change into dry, clean clothes.
quests.funFact: Spare clothes are often kept in a bag or cubby.

quests.instruction: Today is PE (sports class). Which footwear is best?
quests.correctAnswer: Sneakers 👟
quests.explanation: Sneakers are flexible and grip the floor, so they are good for running and jumping.
quests.funFact: Athletic shoes often have cushioned soles that absorb the impact of jumping.

quests.instruction: Before going out the door, Mia looks at the sky and sees dark clouds. What should she bring?
quests.correctAnswer: A raincoat 🌧️
quests.explanation: Dark clouds often mean rain is coming. A raincoat keeps her dry if it starts.
quests.funFact: Dark, heavy clouds often hold lots of water.

quests.instruction: It is a bright day. Omar goes outside to play. What can he wear to protect his head and eyes?
quests.correctAnswer: A cap with a brim 🧢
quests.hint: Think of the sun in your eyes.
quests.explanation: A cap with a brim shades the eyes and forehead from the sun.
quests.funFact: Brims help you see more clearly when the sun is low.

quests.instruction: Zoe is walking to the shop in the evening, and it is getting dark. What would help drivers see her?
quests.correctAnswer: A jacket with reflective strips 🦺
quests.hint: Focus on what shines in headlights.
quests.explanation: Reflective strips bounce light back to drivers, making her easier to spot.
quests.funFact: Dark clothes are harder for drivers to see at night.

quests.instruction: Why are pajamas usually soft and loose?
quests.correctAnswer: So you can sleep comfortably 😴
options: So they can be worn to school 🎒
So they keep you dry in the rain 🌧️
quests.explanation: Soft, loose pajamas don't pinch or rub, so you can rest more easily.
quests.funFact: Good sleep helps the body grow and helps you learn.

quests.instruction: It is a warm summer night. Which sleepwear is best for Ben?
quests.correctAnswer: Light short-sleeved pajamas 🌙
quests.explanation: Light pajamas let air through, so he stays cool and comfortable.
quests.funFact: Many people sleep better in a cool room.

quests.instruction: Why do we change into pajamas instead of sleeping in our school clothes?
quests.correctAnswer: They are clean and made for resting 🛏️
options: They are clean and made for resting 🛏️
They are warmer for walking outside 🧥
They are stiffer and more supportive 🧱
quests.hint: Think about what happened to the clothes today.
quests.explanation: School clothes may be dirty or tight. Pajamas are clean and comfortable for the night.
quests.funFact: Changing clothes is also a signal to the body that it is bedtime.

quests.instruction: Kai is going to play at the playground. Which clothes will let him climb freely?
quests.correctAnswer: Stretchy shirt and shorts or pants 🧗
options: Stretchy shirt and shorts or pants 🧗
A long robe dragging on the ground 👘
quests.hint: He needs to bend, stretch, and climb.
quests.explanation: Clothes that stretch and fit well let you climb, swing, and run safely.
quests.funFact: Loose strings on clothing can catch on playground equipment.

quests.instruction: Why is it better to wear closed shoes than flip-flops when playing tag?
quests.correctAnswer: Flip-flops can slip off and toes can get hurt 🩴
options: Flip-flops are too hot to wear in tag 🔥
Flip-flops can slip off and toes can get hurt 🩴
Closed shoes are faster to take off 👟
quests.explanation: Closed shoes stay on and protect toes, so you can run safely.
quests.funFact: Many playgrounds ask children to wear shoes.

quests.instruction: After playing in mud, Sana's pants are covered in dirt. What should she do when she gets home?
quests.correctAnswer: Put them in the laundry and wear clean ones 🧺
options: Put them in the laundry and wear clean ones 🧺
Fold them into the clean drawer 🗄️
Hang them back in the closet 🚪
quests.explanation: Muddy pants go in the laundry to be washed, so they are clean for next time.
quests.funFact: Mud washes out more easily if you rinse it before washing.

quests.instruction: A family picnic in the sunny park is planned. Which outfit works well?
quests.correctAnswer: Comfortable shirt, shorts, and sun hat 👒
options: Comfortable shirt, shorts, and sun hat 👒
quests.explanation: Light and comfortable clothes with a hat keep you cool and let you play.
quests.funFact: Sitting on grass is more comfortable with clothes that can get a little dirty.

quests.instruction: Priya wants to feed ducks at the pond. The ground near the water is muddy. Which footwear is best?
quests.correctAnswer: Waterproof boots 🥾
quests.explanation: Waterproof boots keep mud and water out, and they wash off easily.
quests.funFact: Wet feet get cold fast, so boots help at muddy ponds.

quests.instruction: At the park, a chilly breeze starts as the sun goes down. What is the easiest fix?
quests.correctAnswer: Put on a jacket from the bag 🧥
options: Put on a jacket from the bag 🧥
Take off her hat to cool down 🧢
quests.explanation: Having a spare layer lets you stay out longer when the temperature drops.
quests.funFact: It cools down in the evening when the sun sets.

quests.instruction: Noor is going to a family celebration and wants to look neat. Which choice does that?
quests.correctAnswer: Clean, ironed clothes 👔
options: Clothes she wore in the mud yesterday 🪣
quests.explanation: Clean, tidy clothes are a way of showing you care about the event.
quests.funFact: Different families and cultures choose different outfits for celebrations.

quests.instruction: Different families wear different clothes for celebrations. What is the best way to choose?
quests.correctAnswer: Choose clean clothes that fit the occasion 🎉
options: Choose clean clothes that fit the occasion 🎉
Wear exactly what everyone else wears 👥
Wear the oldest clothes you own 🧦
quests.hint: There is no single right outfit.
quests.explanation: What people wear to a celebration depends on their family, culture, and event, so think about what is suitable and comfortable.
quests.funFact: Many cultures have special clothes for weddings and festivals.

quests.instruction: Ravi has new shoes for a family event but they are too tight. What is best?
quests.correctAnswer: Wear comfortable shoes that fit 👟
options: Wear them anyway and ignore the pain 😖
quests.hint: Comfort matters for a long event.
quests.explanation: Shoes that fit let you enjoy the event. Tight shoes can cause blisters.
quests.funFact: Breaking in new shoes slowly can prevent blisters.

quests.instruction: Rain is forecast for the walk to school. When should Mia put on her raincoat and boots?
quests.correctAnswer: Before she leaves the house 🚪
options: Only when she gets to school 🏫
quests.hint: Consider when rain gear does its job best.
quests.explanation: Rain gear works best if you put it on before you step outside, so you stay dry from the first step.
quests.funFact: Keeping rain gear near the door makes it quick to grab.

quests.instruction: Where is a good place to hang a wet raincoat after you come inside?
quests.correctAnswer: Near the door, to drip and dry 🚪
options: Near the door, to drip and dry 🚪
quests.hint: Focus on where drips can fall safely.
quests.explanation: Hanging it where air can reach lets it dry and keeps water off your floors and bed.
quests.funFact: Hanging wet clothes in the air helps prevent musty smells.

quests.instruction: Tariq forgot his umbrella but is wearing a hooded jacket in the rain. What can he do?
quests.correctAnswer: Pull the hood up 🧥
options: Hold the jacket over his knees 🦵
quests.hint: He already has a rain cover on him.
quests.explanation: A hood covers the head, so he can stay drier even without an umbrella.
quests.funFact: A hood with a drawstring stays in place better in the wind.

quests.instruction: Sam splashed in a puddle and his socks are soaked. What should he do?
quests.correctAnswer: Change into dry socks 🧦
quests.explanation: Dry socks keep your feet warm. Wet socks pull heat away and can cause blisters.
quests.funFact: Feet that stay wet for a long time may become sore.

quests.instruction: Why should a child take off wet clothes after getting rained on?
quests.correctAnswer: Wet clothes make the body cold 🥶
options: Wet clothes make the body cold 🥶
quests.explanation: Water carries heat away from your skin, so you cool down quickly. Dry clothes help you warm up.
quests.funFact: The body loses heat faster in wet clothes than in dry ones.

quests.instruction: After swimming, Aisha puts her wet swimsuit in a plastic bag. What should she do when she gets home?
quests.correctAnswer: Take it out and hang it to dry 🪟
options: Leave it in the bag for a week 🛍️
Put it in her drawer wet 🗄️
Take it out and hang it to dry 🪟
quests.explanation: Wet swimsuits left in bags can grow mold and smell. Hanging them out lets them dry.
quests.funFact: Rinsing a swimsuit in fresh water helps remove chlorine or salt.

quests.instruction: Yuki checks the weather: cold, dry, and sunny. Which outfit makes the most sense?
quests.correctAnswer: Warm sweater, pants, and hat 🧶
quests.hint: Cold and dry means warm but no rain gear.
quests.explanation: Warm clothes handle the cold, and since it is dry, rain gear isn't needed.
quests.funFact: A sunny day can still be cold.

quests.instruction: Diego has a hot day with outdoor sports. What is the smartest choice?
quests.correctAnswer: Light, breathable clothes and a water bottle 💧
options: Light, breathable clothes and a water bottle 💧
Heavy jeans, a hoodie, and thick wool socks 🧥
A winter coat and a woolly scarf 🧣
quests.explanation: Breathable clothing helps sweat dry and keeps you cool.
quests.funFact: Drinking water helps replace what you lose by sweating.

quests.instruction: Lina can't decide between two sweaters. One is too tight in the arms. Which should she wear?
quests.correctAnswer: The one with room to move her arms ✋
options: The one with room to move her arms ✋
The warmer one, even if it pinches 🔥
The tight one, since it looks smarter 📏
quests.explanation: Clothes that let you move are more comfortable and safer to wear while playing.
quests.funFact: Clothes that are too tight can rub your skin.
